triples.tail_surface: Allow an over-heated pump to cool before servicing
triples.evidence_text: A closed manual shut-off valve may cause a pump which has lost prime to continue to operate without reaching prime, causing dangerous overheating and possible explosive rupture of the pump casing. Personnel could be severely injured. Allow an over-heated pump to cool before servicing.
